statement: Every distributed SQL result, including result column names, equals what SQLite returns for the same statement over the union of the partitions' rows in canonical layout (partition key-range ordinal, partition scan order): the coordinator evaluates final projection, aggregate combination, GROUP BY, HAVING, DISTINCT, ORDER BY (collations, NULLs, storage-class order) and LIMIT/OFFSET, cross-partition joins, FROM-less SELECTs and write-key expressions with an in-memory SQLite of the partitions' exact build over typed rows ingested in that layout; row values and parameters keep their NULL/INTEGER(int64)/REAL/TEXT/BLOB storage class across every request, answer and durable hop through one codec and one versioned durable command format; column types and collations reach the coordinator from the one catalog schema through the one DDL renderer owner; and no JavaScript SQL evaluator, comparator, renderer duplicate, affinity classifier or CREATE TABLE parser remains outside the classified routing/codec/presentation owners. Merge resources are owned, bounded (page bounds on main and temp, adaptive per-partition caps, a killable process for coordinator-evaluated work) and refused with typed outcomes, never truncated.

constraints.statement: Implements the owner decision of 2026-11-17 (SQLite evaluates the merge; delete all JS evaluators/comparators; transport preserves storage classes). It supersedes the detached session's 'no coordinator SQLite connection' exclusion; record that supersession (R09) and the supersession of distributed-select-global-merge-correctness, whose probe pins the deleted combine-spec path.

SQLite is the only SQL evaluator. JavaScript may parse, plan structural rewrites, route by canonical typed keys, encode/decode values, count budgets and present final values through one owner; it never compares, orders, groups, deduplicates, combines or evaluates SQL values or predicates, and never infers affinity or collation.

Every replaced evaluator, comparator, affinity classifier, CREATE TABLE parser, dead merge helper and its pinning tests are deleted in the work package that replaces them, with caller and export closure; no flag, alias, dormant module or unused export survives. Ratchet baselines are tightened, never raised.

Row values and parameters cross every hop, local or remote, in the one TypedRowSet/TypedParams encoding owned by src/query/sql-value-codec.js. No second encoding, no lenient or fallback decoder, no reviver; a non-canonical cell is a typed refusal. Transport-wide serialization strictness is NOT part of this Quest (separate unit with its own payload census); the codec makes rows and params JSON-safe by construction.

Every durable hop that carries SQL values (raft proposal codec, split-mirror replay, transaction-session statement replay, statement-outcome table, CDC row images) is censused and moved to command format v2 embedding the codec's cells, behind a committed upgrade fence. One positional decoder: entries below the fence index decode as v1, an unversioned or v1 entry above the fence is refused with a typed outcome; no position-free lenient dual decoder. v1 retires through snapshot/compaction.

Coordinator rows are ingested with explicit rowids in (partition key-range ordinal, sequence) order, independent of arrival order, and the oracle reference database is built in the same order. Scan-order-dependent SQLite results (integer overflow, compensated REAL sums, MIN/MAX ties across storage classes, GROUP_CONCAT order, bare columns) are therefore compared exactly; no numeric tolerance is permitted.

Each pushdown (partition LIMIT, DISTINCT, WHERE conjunct, semi-join IN, key pruning, partial aggregation) is admitted only under its recorded soundness condition, including: no partition LIMIT under DISTINCT unless DISTINCT is applied over exactly the select list and every ORDER BY term is a function of it; negative LIMIT means no partition LIMIT and negative OFFSET means zero; a pushed conjunct is removed from the coordinator statement and non-deterministic functions (existing determinism classifier) are never pushed; an explicit non-BINARY COLLATE disables key pruning and the semi-join; SUM/AVG/TOTAL are not partial-aggregated in v1; rowid aliases are refused in multi-partition plans.

Each work package lands its candidate green: no interim dual semantic path. Where a later work package completes a capability, the interim is a typed refusal recorded with its bound (the work package that removes it), never a second implementation.

Plan selection is one decision table with explicit soundness conditions; COORDINATOR_EVALUATED is a defined plan, not a fallback. No path concatenates per-partition answers of a non-decomposable statement, truncates rows, or substitutes a JS result when SQLite is unavailable; unavailability is typed (R07, R11).

Seal only against a receipt produced by the differential oracle on the actual base candidate showing failing receipts (at least N1-N11, review items 1-9, witnesses W-A, W-B, W-C, LIMIT -1 [OFFSET 2] returning no rows and the 'Sum( amount )' column name reproduce). The order-dependent aggregate cases (SUM/TOTAL/AVG over [1e16, 1.0 | -1e16]; SUM over [MAX | MAX], [MIN | MAX, MAX], [MAX | 1, -1]) are also red on the candidate and must turn green. Cases the candidate answers correctly today and an unsound pushdown would break (DISTINCT a+0 ... ORDER BY a LIMIT 2; DISTINCT a ... ORDER BY b LIMIT 3; AVG over [MAX | MAX]) are golden regression guards that must stay green. The oracle's corpus, seeds and normalization rules are fixed at seal; they may be extended, never relaxed, and no numeric tolerance exists.

The Quest reproducer includes the external review's three admitted-expression witnesses as permanent golden cases, each through the real parser, planner and executor against native SQLite, with one and with several partitions, and with the same expression in projection and in predicate: W-A two-argument TRIM(MAX(dept),'x') over 'xxabcxx' = 'abc'; W-B CAST(SUM(amount) AS INTEGER) with SUM 1.9 projects 1 and HAVING CAST(SUM(amount) AS INTEGER) = 1 keeps the row (explicit cast truncates toward zero; never comparison affinity), plus the residual JOIN CAST consumer in a join predicate; W-C CASE WHEN '0' THEN SUM(amount) ELSE 0 END = 0 in projection and HAVING (text '0' is false). One evaluator serves projection, HAVING and residual JOIN; no consumer keeps its own copy.

Declared types and collations come only from the catalog schema rendered by the one DDL renderer used by partitions; no coordinator-side CREATE TABLE parsing or sqlite_master lookup. Partition-key columns are BINARY-collated by contract.

Each merge has one owner (CoordinatorMergeSession), one in-memory database with main tables, max_page_count and temp.max_page_count from MEMORY_LIMIT_BYTES, temp_store left at the build default FILE with an explicit cache_size, closed on every exit path; adaptive per-partition caps keep in-flight answer memory within MEMORY_LIMIT_BYTES; MERGE_INPUT_MAX_ROWS and RESULT_MAX_* from the one normalized query budget; a node concurrency bound with backpressure; typed refusals naming the bound. COORDINATOR_EVALUATED work runs in a bounded pool of merge child processes killed at the deadline or CPU_TIME_LIMIT_MS (no in-process interrupt exists in this binding); FRAGMENT_MERGE and PARTIAL_AGGREGATE run on the main thread with chunked ingestion.

Coordinator, merge child processes and partitions merge only under identical sqliteVersion, sqliteSourceId and compileOptionsDigest from the existing envelope owner (classifierListVersion is not compared); a mismatch is a typed refusal.

Treat each problem as systematic until evidence proves it local. Read the real producer and all affected consumers, research prior project failures, trace the first causal divergence and record ruled-out causes before repair. Compare related systems through primary sources only where their contracts apply; do not copy an unavailable capability.

Before a behavior-changing attempt, record the producer/consumer symbols, owner-defined shape, identity/generation, ordering, absent versus unavailable, durable commit, retained obligations, canonical wake and cleanup. Obtain the existing independent design review before changing the codec, schema or budget owner boundaries.

Preserve valid existing repairs and establish evidence applicability before reuse. Use the smallest discriminating proof, then the actual affected interaction with safety, progress and resource evidence. Independent verification binds reviewed content, contracts, fixtures, proof machinery and relevant dependencies; implementation approval and execution evidence are separate.

This record is an unsealed proposal until start measures a real red probe. Required receipt IDs are proof obligations, not executed results. Retain original failures; do not fabricate receipts, relax sealed predicates, widen bounds or use the harness to repair product state.

Writable scope is the epic's authorizes plus an explicit recorded amendment for src/raft (durable format and fence), src/cdc (CDC row images, only if WP7 stays), src/wasm-service/query-budget-constants.js, test/transport and the navigability baselines; transport-wide serialization strictness is excluded. Without the amendment those items become separate bounded units and the receipts that need them stay open.

A FROM-less SELECT never silently drops a clause: it is evaluated in the merge session over the full rendered statement after partition statement admission, and until then ORDER BY, LIMIT, OFFSET, GROUP BY, HAVING and DISTINCT on it are a typed refusal.
Result column names are the names SQLite assigns to the admitted statement text (prepared against an empty mirror schema); rewrites alias their outputs with exactly those names.
